challenge.better_approach: I looked at moving the two behavioural teeth to the cc device's own proofs. The orchestrator ruled the pulse pattern instead: a source read keeps the claim in the tool's proof without loading device code, and it matches tooth 1.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That an AST read of push() is enough to hold the no-cairn behaviour. It holds the structure (guarded import, loud print to stderr, return 0, no spawn in the guard), not a run. Measured: five hollow copies each red the tooth they target.
challenge.prior_art: Tooth 1 (pulse_detached_takes_the_helpers_flags) is the pattern, and bce45318b2e0's FIXME at 3e62b55b5 built it. Ticket f6ecce0822eb tracks dynamic imports in general; this is one live instance, recorded on that ticket's measured list.
challenge.real_collision: None. bce45318b2e0's PROVES keys are unchanged (same tooth names), and this branch stacks on bce45-rebased-on-main, so bce4 is not held.

answers.falsifier: Teeth 2 and 4 green over memory_sync.py as it stands and red over copies with hand-built flags, an unguarded import, a handler returning 1, or a silent skip; the new tooth reds the proof as it stood at 3e62b55b5 at :88 and :143.
answers.from_idea: none, because the orchestrator ruled the shape 2026-11-16 from the measurement that cairn/tools/windowless_spawn/proofs/test_every_detached_spawn_takes_its_flags_from_the_helper.py loads cairn/devices/cc/scripts/memory_sync.py through spec_from_file_location at :88 and :143, the same reach the pulse tooth's static import made (bce45318b2e0's FIXME)
answers.how: Same fix as the pulse tooth: tooth 2 runs the tool's own unhelped_sites over a copy of memory_sync.py plus an AST check that push()'s one Popen runs git ... push -q and spreads **detached_kwargs(); tooth 4 reads by AST that the helper's import sits in a try whose ImportError handler prints CC MEMORY SYNC to stderr and returns 0 with no Popen inside. A new tooth reds any import of cairn.devices or a _load/spec_from_file_location aimed at device code in this proof.
answers.traces_to: RULE 1 (a proof measures only its own component) and Law 8 (a proof a hollow build couldn't pass): a dynamic load is the same reach as an import, only invisible to encapsulation_holds.
answers.what: windowless_spawn's proof holds memory_sync's spawn and its no-cairn skip by reading memory_sync.py's source, so no tooth of the tool's proof runs a device's code.

bullets.text: windowless_spawn's proof stops running memory_sync.py: its teeth read the source, and a new tooth reds any device load in the proof.
